_comment: Home feed fixture served by scripts/mock-backend.mjs at GET /wp-json/3ho-solstice/v1/home. `events` adds catalog-only fields (summary, cover, registrationUrl) per slug — a slug with no bundle fixture (the built-in Summer Solstice) is listed from here alone. `posts` are staff-authored posts: eventSlug scopes one to an event, omit it for everyone. Bodies use the info-page grammar (blank line = paragraph, ∙ = bullet). Re-read on every request — edit and reload.

summer-solstice-2026.name: Summer Solstice Sadhana 2026
summer-solstice-2026.summary: Chardi Kala · A Celebration of Joy. Nine days of Sadhana, White Tantric Yoga® and community in the high desert.

wsol26.summary: Seven days by the lake in Florida: White Tantric Yoga® Dec 17–19, the Solstice on Dec 20, and a program for the whole family.

posts.title: Winter Solstice 2026 registration is open
posts.body:
Join us December 15–21 at Retreats By The Lake in Lake Wales, Florida. Early registration is open now.

∙ White Tantric Yoga® on December 17, 18 and 19
∙ The Solstice itself on December 20
∙ Family and youth program at the Children's Camp

Register early to reserve your spot and the housing option you prefer.

posts.title: Getting to Lake Wales
posts.body:
The nearest airports are Orlando (MCO, about 75 minutes) and Tampa (TPA, about 90 minutes). A shuttle will run from Orlando on December 15 and back on December 21.

∙ Book your shuttle seat when you register
∙ Carpool board opens in November
∙ Parking on site is free

posts.title: Serve at Solstice: seva teams are forming
posts.body:
Every Solstice runs on seva. Kitchen, site crew, children's camp and welcome desk teams are looking for volunteers for the winter event.

Seva shifts come with a discount on registration and a very good breakfast.

posts.title: Thank you, Summer Solstice 2026
posts.body: Photos and recordings from Ram Das Puri are being gathered. We will share them here as they are ready.

posts.title: Save the date: Summer Solstice 2027
posts.body: Summer Solstice Sadhana returns to Ram Das Puri in June 2027. Dates and registration will be announced here first.
